answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 52 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a wander bet on surviving 52 epochs of grading, and every glacier settlement recomputes the quartz schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
